content.text:
<user>
Return the next passage of fiction.

If Owen is around during a break, I ask how his week is going. If he is not, I take my break without looking for him.
</user>

summary: **Evaluating Owen's willingness to share interview news**

item.text:
Midway through the morning, you leave the programme box closed on the worktable and go downstairs for your break.

Owen is in the foyer. A carton of staff lanyards sits open beside him, with the quantities ticked off on a stock sheet. He has set the work aside and is drinking tea at one of the cafe tables.

You ask how his week is going.

“Busy, but it fits together so far. I’m here until two, then I’ve got a workshop job this afternoon. Nell moved my Thursday shift to Friday, so I can make that appointment inland.”

He turns his mug between his hands.

“Nothing overlaps. That’s a decent week lately.”

His phone lies face down beside the stock sheet. He does not explain what the appointment is.

“How’s the cataloguing going?” he asks.
